messages:
Maria (PM): Quick async tally for the quarter — short list of what shipped, what slipped, and immediate next steps.
Alex (Eng): 👍 send the list.
Maria (PM): Shipped: model-routing canary (us-west), batching v1 rollout, public docs update. Slipped: endpoint autoscale (was due this sprint, blocked by PRs), private deployment network tests. Next steps: Alex -> autoscale PR review, Sam -> private network triage, Li -> infra ticket for observability hook, Tanya -> final UX sign-off.
Sam (Eng Lead): Autoscale blockers: one failing unit test and a perf regression on long sequences. PR #432 has a fix but needs another look. @Alex can you spare a review?
Alex (Eng): I can review PR #432 today, aiming EOD. If perf regression persists I’ll add a short perf test harness.
Sam (Eng Lead): Private network tests: intermittent CNI failures during pod warmup. Repro steps in the test log: `kubectl logs -l job=net-check` -> see timeouts at 7s.
Li (SRE): Saw the same in staging. Filed INF-211 for a kube-proxy bump and added a canary job to validate. ETA for infra change: ~5 business days.
Tanya (Design): Uploaded updated modal flows to Figma (link) for the Dedicated deploy UX. Mostly copy + one small layout tweak — should be minor.
Maria (PM): Action items recap: 1) Alex reviews #432 (autoscale). 2) Sam continues CNI triage and posts interim mitigation. 3) Li schedules kube-proxy bump and runs canary job. 4) Tanya finalizes Figma and signs off. I’ll update the OKR doc with shipped/slipped and flag risks to execs.
Alex (Eng): Quick note: leaving a short CR comment to avoid rebase churn — if anyone else touches that area ping me.
Sam (Eng Lead): Also pinged mobile-api team for contract review — they asked for an example payload. Added example to the PR description.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy for model-routing succeeded in us-west-2 (deploy id: dpl-20260317-88).
Maria (PM): Thanks — if anyone’s blocked, drop a quick note here or DM. I’ll circle back tomorrow with an updated doc link and owner table. :thumbsup:
